title: Chapter 167: First Battle With The Demon Tribe
content:
Chapter 167: First Battle With The Demon Tribe

The Zerg puppy pounced on the charging inferior demon. In terms of size, the Zerg puppy still has a certain advantage.

The inferior demon's sharp claws grabbed, and the Zerg puppy's blade arm slashed down. With a "clang", the blade claws collided, making a sound of metal clashing!

The blade arm slashed again, and the sharp claws blocked again. The "clang clang" sounded continuously. The Zerg puppy and the inferior demon were fighting at a very high speed. The fighting instincts of both sides were very strong. When they first fought, they felt that they were evenly matched.

However, the Zerg puppy was a soldier that had undergone a total of four comprehensive upgrades at the Zerg base. Its combat power was already the ceiling level of the non-star soldiers. In addition to the Zerg's terrible fighting instincts and special body structure, it was still a step ahead.

As long as a Zerg puppy found the inferior demon's weakness, the entire Zerg would know the inferior demon's weakness. The Zerg puppy in battle would immediately attack the inferior demon's weakness and quickly kill the inferior demon.

This is the terrible growth rate of the Zerg!

No matter how special the enemy is, as long as the war starts, there will always be weaknesses that can be targeted on a large enough base.

This is true for the Zerg, and it is also true for other races.

However, soldiers of other races may not have time to think carefully about the enemy's weaknesses during the fierce battle, or they may not live to see the end of the war even if they figure it out. The probability of successfully passing on the news of the enemy's weaknesses is extremely low.

This requires the accumulation and summary of long-term wars to discover these details.

The Zerg battlefield details are always monitored by the Queen, updated in real time, and all Zerg members will be notified of new discoveries, so there will be no such problems.

Of course, if the enemy's weaknesses are obvious and others can understand them at a glance, this is not included.

The Zerg puppies and the demons fought fiercely together. The Zerg puppies relied on their own advantages to gradually gain the upper hand and began to kill the demons on a large scale. The demons rushing to the front line continued to disappear in light.

"This Zerg battlefield sacrifice is really strange!"

Naga saw the Zerg battlefield sacrifice ability with her own eyes, and was also confused. She couldn't understand how the Zerg did it.

"Boom...! Boom...!"

The flame demons mixed in the inferior demons continuously released fireballs to attack the Zerg puppies. This cannon-explosion-like attack method had a lot of impact on the Zerg puppies' attack.

"Follow the Zerg! Close support!"

Naga issued a new order to the Naga warriors.

She picked up the bow and arrow, walked to the front of the formation, followed closely behind the Zerg puppies, raised the bow and shot at the flame demons in the inferior demon group in front of her, who kept jumping up and releasing fireballs. Each arrow could shoot down a flame demon.

Naga Long and the powerful Naga warriors followed suit and suppressed the flame demons in the inferior demon group in front of the formation. Although they could not shoot down a flame demon with one arrow, they could interrupt the flame demon's attack and reduce the pressure on the Zerg puppies.

Nearly 150,000 Naga warriors continuously launched attacks into the demon army to suppress the demon army's momentum.

On the battlefield, the Zerg puppies fought in close combat in the front, and the Naga army suppressed the Zerg puppies from a distance in the rear, which was equivalent to the Naga army replacing the Zerg hydralisk.

The demon army did not have long-range attack arms, and the flame demons were at most medium-range attack arms. Given their position, they could not hit the Naga warriors behind the Zerg puppies.

It can be said that the Zerg puppies resisted all the damage for the Naga tribe.

Now there are nearly 180,000 Zerg puppies, launching a full-scale attack. The battle line is getting longer and longer. The Zerg puppies are very aggressive and constantly want to rush over from the flank of the demon army to launch a larger-scale close combat.

The inferior demons of the demon army also kept rushing up to intercept the Zerg puppies.

Originally, the attack was launched by the demon army, but now it has become the Zerg puppies attacking, constantly trying to break through the inferior demon's defense line and put more troops in the rear into battle.

But the combat power of the demon army is indeed stronger than that of the bear goblins. Without so many fancy beliefs, their combat power is very strong, and their combat skills are far superior to those of the bear goblins.

The Zerg puppies' battle line has been expanding to both sides. The bodies of both sides who died on the front line will not be retained. This is more suitable for both sides to fight to their heart's content, and the killing efficiency is very high.

As the battle line lengthens and the number of troops participating in the battle on the front line increases, the number of Zerg puppies and demons is rapidly decreasing.

The sun is setting, and the shadows of people are getting longer and longer. Time is running out.

"Prepare for close combat!"

Naga put away her bow and arrow. She has used up all her arrows and has no arrows left.

The situation of the Naga warriors is similar. They are not professional long-range attack troops and will not carry too many arrows. Their real strength, like the Zerg puppies, is close combat!

Naga looked at the battle ahead and felt that the Naga warriors could not cross the Zerg Zerg to join the battle until all the Zerg Zerglings were killed.

Wu Qing had been watching the battle, and the Queen Zerg was constantly collecting information on the battlefield, especially collecting a lot of data on the demon tribe's troops.

It was getting late, and the Zerg Zerglings could not break through the defense line of the Lesser Demons. With the current efficiency of killing the enemy, this war would definitely not end before dark.

If they wanted to break the deadlock, they still needed to send out the Zerg's explosive mosquitoes to blast a path for the Zerg Zerglings.

130 explosive mosquitoes were used to attack the priest team of the bear goblin tribe, and there were 870 left. Wu Qing estimated the lethality and killing range of the explosive mosquitoes and decided to use the remaining 70 explosive mosquitoes.

The explosive mosquitoes attacked ordinary cluster targets this time, and there was no need to hide. 70 explosive mosquitoes flew directly to the relatively weak position of the demon tribe’s defense line. Under the control of the queen, they dived at high speed and accurately rushed into the calculated position and exploded in the group of inferior demons.

"Boom boom boom!"

A violent explosion sounded, and 70 explosive mosquitoes exploded at the same time, causing huge damage to the demon tribe inferior demons in a certain area.

The inferior demons disappeared in a large area, and a large number of inferior demons fell to the ground.

The Zerg puppies, which were also under the control of the queen, rushed into the explosion area just after the explosion and before the energy shock was completely over!

The Zerg puppies broke through the inferior demon’s defense line at the fastest speed and rushed to the rear of the demon army.

The hole in the Demon Army's defense line that was blown open by the explosive mosquito was like a broken dam, and the Zerg puppies rushed through it like a black torrent.

"Warriors of the Naga tribe! Follow me!"

Naga 妶 led the Naga army and rushed up behind the Zerg puppies.

The Naga tribe personnel responsible for blessing the mystical art of luck constantly blessed the Naga warriors who rushed over with various overflow states, not caring about the consumption of luck.

Naga finally followed the Zerg puppies and rushed to the front line. She looked at the scene that was blown up by the explosive mosquito with some curiosity, and found that the explosion power of this suicide Zerg soldier was much stronger than the fireball of the demon flame, and the killing method was also very different.

She noticed that the Zerg puppies in front carefully took away some of the liquid left by the explosion on the ground. It can be seen from the situation on the ground that these liquids are very corrosive.

The defense line of the demon army was broken in half, and the army was divided into two parts. While the Zerg puppies maintained a strong offensive against the main force of the demon army, they were preparing to encircle and suppress the part of the demon army with fewer troops.

Needless to say, the Naga army with rich combat experience knew how to cooperate.

Following the Zerg puppies, the Naga warriors who had not yet finished shooting arrows remotely suppressed the nearly 80,000 demon army encircled by the Zerg puppies.

The Naga warriors who were preparing for close combat quickly supplemented the shortage of Zerg puppies and launched an encirclement and suppression of the nearly 80,000 demon army.

The Zerg puppies have been short of troops so far, and a large part of their troops are still used to contain the main force of the demon army. If they want to quickly encircle and suppress this part of the demon army, they still need the participation of the Naga army.

With the loss of Zerg puppies in front, Naga warriors gradually became the main force of the encirclement and suppression war.

Naga and Nagalong were both at the forefront, slaughtering the inferior demons in front of them like cutting melons and vegetables.

The well-equipped and skilled Naga warriors have extremely mature tactics to deal with the demon army. They are also blessed with the secret method of luck. With shields and swords, they beat the inferior demons back step by step.

Some inferior demons killed entirely by the Naga tribe did not have enough causal relationship with the Zerg, and left corpses on the battlefield.

However, since the two sides are now in an alliance, this deepens the causal relationship. Most of the enemies killed by the Naga tribe still have enough causal relationship to convert matter and energy in the system.

The only corpses left on the battlefield are the sacrificed Naga warriors and a small number of enemies.

The killing efficiency on the battlefield in this world is very high. It is basically a one-shot killing method without many tricks. This may be affected by the limited combat time in this world. At night, you can't fight, which forces everyone to study how to improve the efficiency of killing the enemy.

People in this world are not afraid of death. They either look lightly on life and death or distort the concept of life and death. The method of exchanging life for life on the battlefield is the most normal method.

The demon army, which was rapidly losing members, was completely annihilated in a very short time under the siege of the Zerg and Naga tribes, which had both advantages in manpower and combat power!

There were still more than 100,000 main forces of the demon army left, with more than 2,000 dog demons as the center, and they were launching a fierce attack on the Zerg puppies with all their strength.

The Zerg puppies, which were at a disadvantage in terms of manpower, had been resisting tenaciously, and suffered many casualties.

Especially after the more than 2,000 dog demons joined the attack, the casualties of the Zerg puppies increased greatly.

The combat power of the one-star dog demons was very strong. With the cooperation of the inferior demons and the flame demons, one dog was in front, and almost every attack could severely injure a Zerg puppy.

When the dog demons were besieged by the Zerg puppies, they would spit out flames and carry out magic attacks. The power of the flames they spewed was stronger than the big fireballs of the flame demons, but they lacked the explosion effect.
